scipio_aemilianus.name: Scipio Aemilianus
scipio_aemilianus.backstory: Roman general and statesman. A man of discipline, law, and iron will. He is the prosecutor in the trial of the Carthaginian dyes.

hasdrubal_the_boetharch.name: Hasdrubal the Boetharch
hasdrubal_the_boetharch.backstory: Carthaginian general defending the honor and resources of his city. He is desperate, sharp-tongued, and fiercely proud.
